note: The user's answer is recorded and the new Goal entry directly follows it with Attended: yes and the right Supersedes: line, but the Decision has Type waiver, not re-lock, so no user re-lock authorizes the new Goal entry.

cites.text: A re-lock needs the user: in one Bash command, append a `## Decision` entry of Type re-lock quoting their words, then a new `## Goal — Locked` entry
Type: <grant | plan-approved | waiver | resolution | re-lock | park | abandon>
